API KEY

Connect an API provider

Use an API key issued to you. Your key stays in CodeStory’s local server memory until you disconnect or stop it.

Provider billing information ↗

The connection check loads a model list. It does not analyze a file. Keys are never stored in browser storage or exported with a story.

LOCAL AI

Your model. Your computer.

Start Ollama or LM Studio and download a text model with JSON-schema support. In LM Studio, load the model and start its server from the Developer tab.

Automatic lifecycle control is available for Ollama.

CodeStory sends requests only to the loopback address on this computer. Choose a downloaded model and disable your runner’s cloud features for offline use. No ChatGPT or API-plan allowance is used by this connection. Runner, address, model and automatic-start preferences are saved locally. Credentials are not part of these preferences. Ollama loads the chosen model automatically when a scan requests it.
